about: The start page's greeting line as the first-paint shell (lib/Service/FirstPaintGreeting.php) and the page (nextcloud-vue CnHeaderWidget) both print it, so the shell and the mounted header read the same (first-paint-skeleton task 2, REQ-FPS-001). Read by tests/Unit/Service/FirstPaintGreetingTest.php and src/components/Workspace/__tests__/StartPageGreeting.fixture.spec.js. en-GB is left out on purpose: its full date differs by one comma between ICU 74 (PHP on the sandbox: 'Monday 5 October 2026') and ICU 78 (Node, Chromium: 'Monday, 5 October 2026'), a CLDR data change outside launchpad; nl and en-US read the same on both versions.

cases.line: Good evening, Pieter · Monday, October 5, 2026 · week 41
